# Game object files of the original link, in link order (format: tools/splits.py).
#
# Generated by tools/tusplit.py from config/tu-evidence.txt and the reference
# graph; edit the generator inputs or hand-edit and keep notes here.
# Boundary markers on unit lines:
#   eh     forced by EH funclet chunks (.text$x: one chunk per object) - reliable
#          that a boundary exists between the neighbouring EH functions; the exact
#          gap is chosen by the cut heuristic
#   guess  chosen only by the reference-graph cut heuristic (cut = weight of
#          nearby references crossing the gap; 0 = none)
# Non-.text ranges follow the functions (see tusplit.py) and are approximate.
# The "extern" lines in the first unit reproduce references from code the
# original /OPT:REF discarded; with one blob per unit, mkblobs also lists every
# library/import reference of all units in the first blob (in original order)
# so LINK's library search order stays as in the original link.
